data.name: Link_Information
data.value:
LINK — Local Interaction Normalized Karma

LINK stands for Local Interaction Normalized Karma — it's how CompanioNation builds trust through real-world connections.

How It Works

  1. Connect — LINK with someone you know in real life using either a QR code (instant, in-person) or an Email invite (confirmed via email). Both methods earn +2 Karma for each user.
  2. Photo Add-on — After linking, either user can upload a photo of the other at any time. The person in the photo must confirm it before either of you earns +2 Karma. There's no cap on how many photos you can upload.
  3. Visibility & Confirmation — LINK photos start hidden and unconfirmed. The person in the photo confirms it's really them (earning +2 Karma for both), then decides whether to make it visible on their profile.

Karma Breakdown

ActionPointsWho Earns
Base LINK (QR or Email)+2Both users
Photo Confirmation (per photo)+2Both users (when subject confirms)

Example: 5 LINKs with 2 photos each = 5 × (2 + 2×2) = +30 Karma!

Tips

  • QR codes auto-refresh every 90 seconds — show yours to someone nearby.
  • Email invites expire after 3 days if not confirmed.
  • You can upload multiple photos per LINK over time.
  • Higher Karma = better search visibility for your profile.
